citation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D.
cancellation_rule: Invoices starting with C are cancellations; cancellation and negative-quantity rows are excluded before aggregation.
aggregation: Summed to product-day with one constant store and empty = unknown; the no-negative-quantity check applies to the aggregated product-day values.
notes: No store column; one constant store is assumed.
No stock and no empty-shelf flag; empty = unknown.
Used for Demand watch mode and the data contract only; never a headline claim.
